::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}

The calculus notes are split across these pages:

- [Derivatives](calculus-derivatives.qmd):
  [limits](calculus-derivatives.qmd#def-limit) and [derivatives](calculus-derivatives.qmd#def-derivative),
  [derivative](calculus-derivatives.qmd#def-derivative) rules, [tangent lines](calculus-derivatives.qmd#def-tangent-line),
  and [linear approximation](calculus-derivatives.qmd#def-linear-approximation).
- [Taylor Series](calculus-taylor-series.qmd):
  Taylor and [Maclaurin polynomials](calculus-taylor-series.qmd#def-maclaurin-polynomial),
  and [Taylor series](calculus-taylor-series.qmd#def-taylor-series).
- [Integrals and the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus](calculus-integration.qmd):
  antiderivatives, regularity conditions,
  and the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus.
- [Double Integrals and Fubini's Theorem](calculus-double-integrals.qmd):
  double integrals over rectangles and non-rectangular regions,
  and Fubini's and Tonelli's theorems.

A link to a section, theorem or definition on this page from before the split
goes on to the page that now holds it.

# Further reading {#sec-additional-resources}

- @mosaiccalc
- @khuri2003advanced
- @calclifesaver
- @larsonCalc11e
- @problifesavercalc
  The calculus review exercises and worked solutions across these pages and in [Vector Calculus](vector-calculus.qmd#def-partial-derivative) are adapted from this supplemental review chapter.
   - <http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xYzQL0TUtBA>
   - <http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ps2SBo_WjoE>
- @realanalysislifesaver (the rigorous foundations behind these results)
- @nield2022essential
  reviews exponents, logarithms, limits, derivatives, partial derivatives, and integrals (Chapter 1),
  with Python examples and few proofs.
- [Essence of Calculus](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLZHQObOWTQDMsr9K-rj53DwVRMYO3t5Yr)
  is a 12-video YouTube playlist by Grant Sanderson (3Blue1Brown) that develops geometric and visual intuition for limits, derivatives, product and chain rules, implicit differentiation, integration, and Taylor series.
